purpose: Context KB for pacs.010 FinancialInstitutionDirectDebit auto-fixing. For each XML tag: datatype, mandatory, errors, possible_fixes.

iso_20022_rules.NbOfTxsMatch: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the total number of DrctDbtTxInf occurrences across all CdtInstr blocks.
iso_20022_rules.CdtInstrNbOfTxsMatch: When present, CdtInstr/NbOfTxs must equal the number of DrctDbtTxInf occurrences inside that CreditInstruction.
iso_20022_rules.CtrlSumMatch: When present, GrpHdr/CtrlSum must equal the sum of all DrctDbtTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt values; CdtInstr/CtrlSum must equal the sum within that CreditInstruction.
iso_20022_rules.FinancialInstitutionParties: Dbtr and Cdtr are financial institutions (BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification6 / FinancialInstitutionIdentification18). They carry FinInstnId, not customer PartyIdentification (no Id/PrvtId/Birth date).
iso_20022_rules.SettlementAmountCurrency: All amount elements carry a mandatory Ccy attribute that must be a valid ISO 4217 active currency code; the value must be a non-negative decimal with at most 5 fraction digits.
iso_20022_rules.DirectDebitTransactionMandatory: Each CdtInstr must contain at least one DrctDbtTxInf [1..n], and each DrctDbtTxInf must carry PmtId/EndToEndId and IntrBkSttlmAmt.
iso_20022_rules.SettlementDatePresence: Interbank settlement date may be carried at CdtInstr level or at DrctDbtTxInf level; when present it must be a valid ISODate.
iso_20022_rules.XSDAmountConstraints: ActiveCurrencyAndAmount: fractionDigits=5, totalDigits=18, minInclusive=0. Currency Ccy attribute is REQUIRED. This applies to IntrBkSttlmAmt, CdtInstr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt, and GrpHdr/CtrlSum.
iso_20022_rules.XSDBICFIPattern: BICFIDec2014Identifier pattern: [A-Z0-9]{4,4}[A-Z]{2,2}[A-Z0-9]{2,2}([A-Z0-9]{3,3})?. Applies to all FinInstnId/BICFI in CdtInstr/Cdtr, CdtInstr/CdtrAgt, DrctDbtTxInf/Dbtr, DrctDbtTxInf/DbtrAgt.
iso_20022_rules.XSDIBANPattern: IBAN2007Identifier: [A-Z]{2,2}[0-9]{2,2}[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,30}. Max 34 chars. Used in CdtInstr/CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN and DrctDbtTxInf/DbtrAcct/Id/IBAN.
iso_20022_rules.XSDUUIDPattern: UUIDv4Identifier: [a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}. Mandatory in DrctDbtTxInf/PmtId/UETR under CBPR+.
iso_20022_rules.XSDNbOfTxsPattern: Max15NumericText: [0-9]{1,15}. NbOfTxs counts CdtInstr blocks (NOT DrctDbtTxInf inside them). Example: 1 CdtInstr with 3 DrctDbtTxInf → NbOfTxs=1.
iso_20022_rules.XSDPacs010v06Changes: pacs.010.001.06 (vs .001.03): Added SplmtryData at message level. DrctDbtTxInf sequence: PmtId, PmtTpInf, IntrBkSttlmAmt, IntrBkSttlmDt, Dbtr, DbtrAcct, DbtrAgt, Purp, RmtInf, SplmtryData. CdtInstr mandatory children: CdtId (mandatory), then SttlmInf, then Cdtr, then DrctDbtTxInf.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02) is mandatory for all CBPR+ exchanges and must precede the Document.
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' for the pacs.010 service under SR2025.
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'pacs.010.001.03' and match the Document namespace identifier.
AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must be a unique Max35Text business message identifier.
AppHdr/CreDt must use ISODateTime with an explicit timezone offset (e.g. +00:00); the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden.
DateTime fields (CreDtTm, CreDt) must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; Z suffix and fractional seconds are forbidden.
UETR (DrctDbtTxInf/PmtId/UETR) is mandatory under CBPR+ and must be a lowercase UUID v4.
If FinInstnId/BICFI is present, Nm and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present in the same FinInstnId block (BICFI exclusivity).
BICFI must follow ISO 9362: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
All proprietary/text fields are limited to the FIN-X character set; spaces are not permitted in identifiers.
BranchIdentification (BrnchId) is removed from agent elements under CBPR+ SR2025.
Interbank settlement date must be the current date or a future business day; past dates are rejected.

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ messages; wraps the pacs.010 Document.

errors.description: AppHdr element is absent; CBPR+ mandates BusinessApplicationHeaderV02.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block before the <Document> element.
Ensure AppHdr contains Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc and CreDt.

tags.description: Sending MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 (Fr/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI) when exchanged on SWIFT.

errors.description: Fr element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{sender_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from the first CdtInstr/Cdtr or the instructing institution.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters following ISO 9362.
Example valid BIC: DEUTDEFFXXX

tags.description: Receiving MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 (To/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI) on SWIFT.

errors.description: To element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{receiver_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from the first CdtInstr/Dbtr or the instructed institution.

errors.description: AppHdr/To contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the Business Message. Must be a unique Max35Text value with no spaces.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizMsgIdr>{unique Max35Text value}</BizMsgIdr> inside AppHdr.
Use format MSG-YYYYMMDD-NNN (e.g. MSG-20260601-001).

errors.description: BizMsgIdr exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the value to a maximum of 35 characters.
Ensure the truncated value remains meaningful and unique.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must equal 'pacs.010.001.03' and match the Document namespace.

errors.description: MsgDefIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgDefIdr>pacs.010.001.03</MsgDefIdr> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
possible_fixes: Read the xmlns attribute from the Document root (urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pacs.010.001.03).
Set MsgDefIdr to 'pacs.010.001.03' with no trailing spaces or version mismatch.

tags.description: Business Service identifier. Mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025; must be 'swift.cbprplus.02'.

errors.description: BizSvc is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.02</BizSvc> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: BizSvc contains an incorrect value for the pacs.010 service.
possible_fixes: Replace value with 'swift.cbprplus.02'.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the Business Message. Must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; 'Z' and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDt>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDt> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under CBPR+.
AppHdr/CreDt has no timezone offset; CBPR+ requires an explicit offset.

tags.description: Unique message identifier assigned by the instructing party. No spaces; max 35 characters.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgId>{unique identifier up to 35 chars}</MsgId> as first child of GrpHdr.
Use format MSG-YYYYMMDD-NNN (e.g. MSG-20260601-001).

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 35 characters preserving meaningful prefix.

errors.description: MsgId contains characters outside the FIN-X character set or contains spaces.
possible_fixes: Remove spaces from MsgId.
Allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + (no leading or trailing spaces).

tags.description: Creation date and time of the message. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; Z suffix and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDtTm>.

errors.description: CreDtTm uses 'Z' suffix; forbidden under CBPR+.
CreDtTm has no timezone offset; CBPR+ requires an explicit offset.

tags.description: Total number of direct debit transactions in the message. Must equal the count of all DrctDbtTxInf blocks across every CdtInstr.

errors.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs is absent.
possible_fixes: Count all DrctDbtTxInf blocks across all CdtInstr and insert <NbOfTxs>{count}</NbOfTxs>.

errors.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs does not equal the actual total number of DrctDbtTxInf blocks.
possible_fixes: Count all DrctDbtTxInf elements across every CdtInstr and set NbOfTxs to that total.

errors.description: NbOfTxs contains non-numeric characters.
possible_fixes: Replace with a numeric integer string (max 15 digits). Example: '1'.

tags.description: Control sum. If present, must equal the sum of all DrctDbtTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt values across the message.

errors.description: GrpHdr/CtrlSum does not equal the sum of all IntrBkSttlmAmt values.
possible_fixes: Sum all DrctDbtTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt values and set CtrlSum to the result.
Remove CtrlSum if it is not required to avoid mismatch errors.

errors.description: CtrlSum contains a non-numeric or invalid decimal value.
possible_fixes: Use a valid decimal number format (e.g. 1000.00).
Maximum 18 digits total with up to 5 fraction digits.

tags.description: Initiating party of the financial institution direct debit. Optional party identification at group level.

errors.description: InitgPty/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate InitgPty/Nm to a maximum of 140 characters.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the CreditInstruction block. Max 35 characters, no spaces.

errors.description: CdtInstr/CdtId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CdtId>{unique credit instruction id up to 35 chars}</CdtId> as first child of CdtInstr.
Example: CDT-20260601-001

errors.description: CdtInstr/CdtId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate CdtId to maximum 35 characters preserving the unique prefix.

tags.description: Batch booking indicator. true = one credit entry for the batch; false = individual entries. Boolean indicator.

errors.description: BtchBookg contains a value other than the boolean 'true' or 'false'.
possible_fixes: Replace with the boolean literal 'true' or 'false'.
Remove BtchBookg if batch booking does not apply.

tags.description: Number of direct debit transactions within this CreditInstruction. If present, must equal the count of DrctDbtTxInf in this CdtInstr.

errors.description: CdtInstr/NbOfTxs does not equal the number of DrctDbtTxInf blocks inside this CreditInstruction.
possible_fixes: Count DrctDbtTxInf elements within this CdtInstr and set NbOfTxs to that count.
Remove CdtInstr/NbOfTxs if not required.

tags.description: Control sum for this CreditInstruction. If present, must equal the sum of IntrBkSttlmAmt for the DrctDbtTxInf within this CdtInstr.

errors.description: CdtInstr/CtrlSum does not equal the sum of IntrBkSttlmAmt within this CreditInstruction.
possible_fixes: Sum the IntrBkSttlmAmt of all DrctDbtTxInf in this CdtInstr and set CtrlSum to that value.
Remove CdtInstr/CtrlSum if not required.

tags.description: Total interbank settlement amount for this CreditInstruction, with mandatory Ccy attribute. If present, currency must match the DrctDbtTxInf IntrBkSttlmAmt currencies.

errors.description: TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt is present but the Ccy attribute is missing.
possible_fixes: Add a Ccy attribute with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter currency code.
Example: <TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy="USD">{amount}</TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt>

errors.description: TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt currency or value differs from the sum/currency of the DrctDbtTxInf IntrBkSttlmAmt.
possible_fixes: Align TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt currency and value with the sum of all DrctDbtTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt in this CdtInstr.
Remove TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt if alignment is not possible.

tags.description: Interbank settlement date at CreditInstruction level. ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or a future business day.

errors.description: CdtInstr/IntrBkSttlmDt is in the past.
possible_fixes: Replace with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the next valid business day.
Do NOT use 'Z', time components or offsets — date only.

errors.description: CdtInstr/IntrBkSttlmDt is not in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. includes time, Z suffix or slashes).
possible_fixes: Use date-only format YYYY-MM-DD with no time component.

tags.description: Settlement method for the CreditInstruction. INGA/INDA = settled on books of instructing/instructed agent; CLRG = clearing system; COVE = cover.

errors.description: SttlmMtd is absent from SttlmInf when SttlmInf is present.
possible_fixes: Insert <SttlmMtd>INGA</SttlmMtd> as first child of SttlmInf.

errors.description: SttlmMtd contains a value not in the allowed codelist.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: INGA, INDA, CLRG, COVE.
Use INGA for standard interbank settlement on the instructing agent's books.

tags.description: Creditor financial institution of the CreditInstruction (BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification). Must contain FinInstnId with BICFI (or Nm/PstlAdr when BICFI absent). Not a customer party.

errors.description: Cdtr block is absent from CdtInstr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Cdtr><FinInstnId><BICFI>{creditor_institution_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Cdtr>.

errors.description: Cdtr/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

errors.description: BICFI exclusivity: Cdtr/FinInstnId/BICFI is present but Nm and/or PstlAdr also appear in the same FinInstnId.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from Cdtr/FinInstnId when BICFI is present.
Or remove BICFI and retain Nm/PstlAdr.

tags.description: Account of the creditor financial institution. Identified by IBAN or Othr (mutually exclusive). Optional.

errors.description: CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails ISO 13616 format or MOD97 checksum validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN: 2-letter country + 2 check digits + BBAN (max 34 chars).
Verify MOD97 check digit computation. Example: DE89370400440532013000

tags.description: Creditor agent of the CreditInstruction (financial institution). BICFI mandatory on SWIFT when present. BrnchId removed under CBPR+.

errors.description: CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid 8 or 11 character BICFI.

errors.description: BICFI exclusivity: CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI present together with Nm and/or PstlAdr.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from CdtrAgt/FinInstnId when BICFI is present.

tags.description: Payment identification block of the direct debit transaction. Contains InstrId, EndToEndId and UETR (mandatory under CBPR+).

errors.description: PmtId block is absent from DrctDbtTxInf.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <PmtId> block containing EndToEndId and UETR (and optionally InstrId).

tags.description: Instruction identification assigned by the instructing party for the transaction. Optional, max 16 characters (CBPR+ RestrictedFINXMax16Text).

errors.description: InstrId exceeds 16 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate InstrId to maximum 16 characters.
Remove InstrId if it is not required.

tags.description: End-to-end identification assigned by the initiating party. Must be passed through unchanged. 'NOTPROVIDED' is allowed.

errors.description: EndToEndId is absent from PmtId.
possible_fixes: Insert <EndToEndId>NOTPROVIDED</EndToEndId> if the value is unknown.
Otherwise insert <EndToEndId>{end-to-end reference, max 35 chars}</EndToEndId>.

errors.description: EndToEndId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters maximum.
Use 'NOTPROVIDED' if the reference cannot be preserved within the length limit.

tags.description: Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference. UUID v4 format. Schema-optional but mandatory under CBPR+ for pacs.010.

errors.description: UETR is absent from PmtId; mandatory under CBPR+.
possible_fixes: Insert <UETR>{valid UUID v4}</UETR> after EndToEndId in PmtId.
Example valid UETR: 4a1a0945-5772-409a-83ba-240e666e0267
Generate a new UUID v4: lowercase hex, format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx where y in {8,9,a,b}.

errors.description: UETR is not a valid UUID v4 (wrong format, uppercase, wrong version digit or invalid variant).
possible_fixes: Ensure UETR is lowercase hex in format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.
The 13th character (version) must be '4'; the 17th (variant) must be 8, 9, a or b.
Total length must be exactly 36 characters including hyphens.
Convert any uppercase hex characters to lowercase.

tags.description: Payment type information for the direct debit transaction. Optional; Cd and Prtry within service level / local instrument are mutually exclusive.

errors.description: PmtTpInf/SvcLvl has both Cd and Prtry present; they are mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Prtry if Cd is the correct choice.
Remove Cd if Prtry is the correct choice.

tags.description: Interbank settlement amount with mandatory Ccy attribute. Amount > 0; Ccy is a valid ISO 4217 code.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmAmt element is absent from DrctDbtTxInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <IntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy="{ISO4217_currency}">{amount}</IntrBkSttlmAmt>.
Ensure the Ccy attribute is a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmAmt is present but the Ccy attribute is missing.
possible_fixes: Add a Ccy attribute with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter currency code.
Example: <IntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy="USD">{amount}</IntrBkSttlmAmt>

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmAmt amount is zero or negative.
possible_fixes: Replace with a positive decimal amount greater than zero.
Maximum 18 digits total, 5 fraction digits.

tags.description: Interbank settlement date at transaction level. ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or a future business day.

errors.description: DrctDbtTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt is in the past.
possible_fixes: Replace with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the next valid business day.
Do NOT use 'Z', time components or offsets — date only.

errors.description: DrctDbtTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt is not in YYYY-MM-DD format.
possible_fixes: Use date-only format YYYY-MM-DD with no time component.

tags.description: Debtor financial institution (BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification). Must contain FinInstnId with BICFI (or Nm/PstlAdr when BICFI absent). Not a customer — no Id/PrvtId/Birth date.

errors.description: Dbtr block is absent from DrctDbtTxInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <Dbtr><FinInstnId><BICFI>{debtor_institution_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Dbtr>.
If BICFI unavailable, use <Dbtr><FinInstnId><Nm>{institution_name}</Nm><PstlAdr><Ctry>{CC}</Ctry></PstlAdr></FinInstnId></Dbtr>.

errors.description: Dbtr/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

errors.description: BICFI exclusivity: Dbtr/FinInstnId/BICFI is present together with Nm and/or PstlAdr.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from Dbtr/FinInstnId when BICFI is present.
Or remove BICFI and retain Nm/PstlAdr.

errors.description: Dbtr/FinInstnId/PstlAdr is present but Ctry is missing.
possible_fixes: Add <Ctry>{ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code}</Ctry> inside PstlAdr.
Example: <Ctry>GB</Ctry>

tags.description: Account of the debtor financial institution. Identified by IBAN or Othr (mutually exclusive). Optional.

errors.description: DbtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails ISO 13616 format or MOD97 checksum validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN: 2-letter country + 2 check digits + BBAN (max 34 chars).
Verify MOD97 check digit computation. Example: GB29NWBK60161331926819

errors.description: Both IBAN and Othr are present in DbtrAcct/Id; they are mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Othr if IBAN is the correct identifier.
Remove IBAN if Othr is the correct identifier.

tags.description: Debtor agent of the transaction (financial institution). Mandatory; must contain a valid BICFI on SWIFT. BrnchId removed under CBPR+.

errors.description: DbtrAgt is absent from DrctDbtTxInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <DbtrAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{debtor_agent_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></DbtrAgt>.

errors.description: DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid 8 or 11 character BICFI.

errors.description: BICFI exclusivity: DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI present together with Nm and/or PstlAdr.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from DbtrAgt/FinInstnId when BICFI is present.

tags.description: Purpose of the direct debit. Cd (ISO 20022 external Purpose code) and Prtry are mutually exclusive.

errors.description: Purp/Cd is not in the ISO 20022 external Purpose code list.
possible_fixes: Use a valid ISO 20022 Purpose code: e.g. TREA (treasury), CASH, INTC (intra-company), GDDS.
Alternatively use Purp/Prtry with a proprietary code (max 35 chars).

errors.description: Both Purp/Cd and Purp/Prtry are present; mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Prtry if Cd is the correct choice.
Remove Cd if Prtry is the correct choice.

tags.description: Remittance information. Ustrd and Strd are mutually exclusive within the same RmtInf block.

errors.description: Both Ustrd and Strd are present in the same RmtInf block; mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Strd if unstructured remittance is preferred.
Remove Ustrd if structured remittance is preferred.

errors.description: Ustrd text exceeds 140 characters per occurrence.
possible_fixes: Truncate each Ustrd occurrence to maximum 140 characters.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'pacs.010.001.03' and match the Document namespace.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set MsgDefIdr to 'pacs.010.001.03' to match the Document xmlns identifier.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must be a unique Max35Text business message identifier.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Generate or retain a unique Max35Text value; do not duplicate across messages.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the total count of DrctDbtTxInf blocks across all CdtInstr.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Count all DrctDbtTxInf elements across every CdtInstr and update GrpHdr/NbOfTxs.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CdtInstr/NbOfTxs (when present) must equal the count of DrctDbtTxInf inside that CdtInstr.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Count DrctDbtTxInf within the CdtInstr and update CdtInstr/NbOfTxs, or remove it.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/CtrlSum (when present) must equal the sum of all DrctDbtTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Sum all IntrBkSttlmAmt values and update GrpHdr/CtrlSum, or remove CtrlSum.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CdtInstr/CtrlSum (when present) must equal the sum of IntrBkSttlmAmt within that CdtInstr.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Sum the IntrBkSttlmAmt of all DrctDbtTxInf in the CdtInstr and update CdtInstr/CtrlSum, or remove it.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CdtInstr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt (when present) currency and value must align with the DrctDbtTxInf IntrBkSttlmAmt totals.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Align TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt currency and value with the sum of DrctDbtTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt, or remove TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: DrctDbtTxInf/PmtId/UETR is mandatory under CBPR+ and must be a lowercase UUID v4.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert a valid lowercase UUID v4 when absent; convert to lowercase / regenerate when malformed.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BICFI exclusivity: when FinInstnId/BICFI is present, Nm and PstlAdr MUST NOT appear in the same FinInstnId block (applies to Dbtr, Cdtr, DbtrAgt, CdtrAgt).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from the FinInstnId when BICFI is present.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Interbank settlement date must be today or a future business day at both CdtInstr and DrctDbtTxInf levels.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Replace any past IntrBkSttlmDt with today's date or the next valid business day.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Dbtr and Cdtr are financial institutions; party-level identification (Id/PrvtId, birth date) is not applicable.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Use FinInstnId/BICFI (or FinInstnId/Nm+PstlAdr); remove any customer PartyIdentification fields.

schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc is 'swift.cbprplus.02' for the pacs.010 CBPR+ service.
schema_mapping_notes.structure: GrpHdr [1..1] then CdtInstr [1..n] (CreditInstruction); each CdtInstr carries Cdtr/CdtrAgt and one or more DrctDbtTxInf [1..n].
schema_mapping_notes.parties_are_financial_institutions: Dbtr, Cdtr, DbtrAgt and CdtrAgt are financial institutions identified via FinInstnId/BICFI (or Nm+PstlAdr). They are NOT customer parties — no Id/PrvtId, name-as-individual, or date-of-birth fields apply.
schema_mapping_notes.uetr: DrctDbtTxInf/PmtId/UETR is schema-optional but mandatory under CBPR+; it must be a lowercase UUID v4.
schema_mapping_notes.settlement_date_levels: IntrBkSttlmDt may appear at CdtInstr level and/or DrctDbtTxInf level; both are optional in the base schema.
schema_mapping_notes.amounts: TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt and IntrBkSttlmAmt are ActiveCurrencyAndAmount with a mandatory ISO 4217 Ccy attribute.
